title: Commitment Gradient Mediator & Utilization Signal Normalizer
author: Aisha Nair
description:
Motivation: Dedicated fleet autoscaling observed short-term oscillations when reservation adjustments and burst allocations reacted to raw utilization spikes. This caused repeated micro-resizes and transient headroom churn that bumped 95th percentile tail latency under sustained bursty traffic.

This PR introduces two coordinated pieces: (1) a Commitment Gradient Mediator that blends reservation deltas using a tunable multi-window gradient (fast/medium/slow) to avoid aggressive reservation flips; (2) a Utilization Signal Normalizer that attenuates short-lived util spikes and exposes a stabilized percentile-based utilization signal to the autoscaler and billing telemetry.

Highlights (single continuous description):
- Adds a GradientMediator component inside pkg/autoscaler that computes a smoothed reservation delta using weighted gradients across 3 windows (10s, 60s, 5m) and a configurable momentum term. The mediator enforces a commit rate cap and a minimum hold window to avoid churn.
- Introduces telemetry/reservations/normalizer.go: performs per-tenant utilization normalization, switching between low-pass filtering and robust-percentile gating when signal variance exceeds threshold. Emits util_normalizer.{raw,smoothed,pct_var} metrics for debugging and downstream gating.
- Integrates mediator outputs with existing dedicated allocation controller: decisions now require both mediator-consensus and health-check-stable before adjusting GKE/instancegroup reservations.
- Backfills unit + e2e coverage: autoscaler/mediator_test.go (unit), e2e/dedicated-mediator-smoke.yaml (integration test harness using synthetic spike generator).
- Adds a lightweight canary for 10% of tenants behind a feature flag to monitor impact before global rollout.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc (docs/design/commitment-gradient.md) reviewed by SRE and Autoscale WG
- [x] Unit tests added and passing
- [x] Integration smoke test validated in perf-lab cluster (5 runs)
- [x] Telemetry dashboard prototype created (dashboards/dedicated/commitment-gradient.json)
- [x] Feature-flag gating and rollout plan included

Operational impact: In our perf-lab runs the mediator reduced reservation oscillation events by ~68% and lowered headroom churn (measured as reservation toggles per-minute) from median 0.9 -> 0.13 for synthetic mixed workloads. Observed 95th latency improved ~12% for bursty scenarios during the canary window.

Compatibility and rollout: Default behavior is opt-in via feature flag. We will enable the 10% canary for 48 hours, evaluate stability, then bump gradually. No breaking changes to RPC/schemas.

Related: ENG-4432 (autoscaler stability), ENG-4510 (dedicated billing signals).
